lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀，从一棵树到另一棵。
lines.en: I flap from one tree to the next.
The dawn light is right, so I'm out flying.
I don't fly fast; my body is heavy.
I circle a cluster of orange.
Fine lines run across my wings.
I settle down against the bark.

lines.zh: 我找那朵还没开的花苞。
lines.en: I look for the bud that hasn't opened.
The wind pushes me, and I come back.
I squeeze between the leaves.

lines.zh: 我在林子里飞了一大圈。
lines.en: I fly a long circuit through the wood.
I stop on the trunk to rest.
I fly toward that sweetness.

lines.zh: 我沉甸甸地飞过低处的草。
lines.en: I lumber low over the grass.
I drop low and hide under a leaf.
I hover in midair for a moment.
I circle back to this tree again.
I spread my wings flat in the sun.
My antennae stir gently.
Dawn is near, and I'm waking.
There aren't many flowers around here.

lines.zh: 我昨天把一朵花吃光了。
lines.en: I ate a whole flower yesterday.
My wings are a little torn.
I'm not moving much.
My time is nearly up.
There's a bird in the tree.
I draw my legs together.

lines.zh: 我在树皮上留下一点粉。
lines.en: I leave a little dust on the bark.
I can smell rain.
Move aside — that flower is mine.
Your hand is warmer than a petal.

lines.zh: 你的手里有橙色的东西吗？
lines.en: Is there something orange in your hand?

lines.zh: 我翅膀的粉，蹭白你的袖子。
lines.en: The dust on my wings whitens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我不飞远，就在这片花上。
lines.en: I won't fly far; just these flowers.
Look up, and I'm there.
I have only a short time.
Don't drop a net over me.
Hold still, I've lost my bearings.
I peek at you from behind a leaf.
I drop onto a leaf.
My left wing won't answer me.
Dust scatters everywhere.
I pause before moving.
I crawl two steps.
I press against the bark.
I can only lie flat on the leaf.
My antennae have stopped.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪斜，翅擦过一朵花苞。
lines.en: I'm knocked askew, my wing scraping a flower bud.
I want somewhere to hide.
An orange bud — that's the one.
The sap in the bud is sweet.
I'll eat the whole flower.
That isn't enough for my eggs.
An orange petal holds me up.
This one is still open.
Hold still; I'm eating.

lines.zh: 甜味从花苞那边飘过来。
lines.en: Sweetness drifts over from that bud.
This one hasn't fully opened.
I leave nothing but the stem.
The knock leaves my antennae numb.
Some of my dust came off.
I tumble into your hair.
Don't swat; my wings are thin.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我又飞起来。
lines.en: We collided, and I'm up again.
I circle behind your hat.
I flew into the window.
I cling to the wall and slide down.
You knocked some scales off me.
I paused before flying off.

lines.zh: 另一只停在另一片叶上。
lines.en: Another one rests on another leaf.
I beat my wings for her.
She's a little bigger, paler in color.
I fly two circles around her.
We settle side by side on the trunk.
I'll lay my eggs on the leaves.
My eggs must go on the underside of leaves.
They'll settle elsewhere.
After this, my time will be brief.
We won't meet again.
You've cupped me in your hands.

lines.zh: 我的六只脚抱住你的手指不放。
lines.en: All six of my feet clamp onto your finger.
I circle in your palm.
I can't grip your hand.

lines.zh: 我掉了一些粉在你手上。
lines.en: Some dust came off on your hand.
There are no flowers here.
I crawl to your fingertip.
You had better put me down.
I'm going to fly; let go.
I rest on your cuff.
There's already one on this flower.
Something is on the flower.
I fly straight at that flower.
I have to drive it off.
I fly at it.
My antennae are up.
It's a little smaller than I am.
Locked on — just that spot.
I lower my wings and aim at it.
My wings are half open.
I hover over its head.
I drop low and fly in close.
It hides under a leaf.
I follow it down.
My wings beat faster.
One more hit and it drops.
It's rising.
I change direction.

lines.zh: 我把橙色郁金香的花苞吃空了。
lines.en: I hollowed out an orange tulip bud.
It moved once more.
I'm big, but I fly clumsily.
My wings beat against it.
I push it with my legs.
I shove it off the leaf.
I fall with it.
That was too light.
I dart at its eyes.
It hasn't left; it's still on the flower.
I rest on the leaf, panting.
My wing hurts a little.
My wings will take a while to dry.
My wings are still wet; I must wait.
Dawn is near; I must hurry.
I open my first pair of wings.
The wood is all leaves.
I can smell where the flowers are.
I shudder, and dust falls.
I start climbing into the air.
I have only a few short days.
My days are few; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的翅膀卷成了片。
lines.en: One lick of fire and my wings curl up.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下去，摔在草里。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and land in the grass.

lines.zh: 雨点把我压在地上，我起不来。
lines.en: A raindrop pins me down and I can't rise.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得看不见方向。
lines.en: The blast blows me off any course.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，掀走了我半边粉。
lines.en: An arrow grazes me and takes half my dust.
That light stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 没吃到花，我飞得越来越低。
lines.en: With no flowers, I fly lower and lower.

lines.zh: 橙色花苞没吃到，先被雷。
lines.en: Didn't get the orange buds — got lightning.

lines.zh: 没有树，也没有风，我在往下掉。
lines.en: No trees, no wind; I just fall.
